detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Foundation – Harvest Festival

Transform your village into a thriving hub of agriculture with the Harvest Festival DLC.

Raise livestock, cultivate new crops, and plant bountiful orchards as you expand your village’s rural economy with new production chains and resources. Then bring it all together by hosting an increasingly prestigious Harvest Festival, culminating in the grandest celebration in the realm.

Key Features

  • New Aspiration: Become the Master of Harvests, developing your agricultural economy and hosting an increasingly prestigious Harvest Festival.

  • Common Crofts: Raise chickens, pigs, and geese in modular Common Crofts to sustain your growing population.

  • Bountiful Orchards: Grow apples, plums, and hazelnuts across three new specialized Orchard Farms.

  • Vegetable Farming: Diversify your fields with dedicated plots for cabbages and turnips.

  • The Ultimate Celebration: Expand your Tavern with the customizable Festival Grounds and prepare the perfect Harvest Festival. Cook feasts, serve drinks, hire entertainers, and grow a modest gathering into the most prestigious celebration in the realm.

DLC Content Includes

  • 10 New Buildings: A modular Common Croft, 3 Orchard Farms, 2 Vegetable Farms, Drying Kiln, Cider House, the Tavern’s Festival Grounds, the Monastic Croft, totalling more than 120 new building parts.

  • 14 New Resources: Including Pigs, Chickens, Geese, Eggs, Apples, Plums, Hazelnuts, Cider, Cabbages, Turnips and more.

  • A Grand Harvest Festival: The Harvest Festival, featuring unlockable decorations and unique rewards.

  • New Progression: A dedicated Aspiration and a prestigious new Village Title.

  • New Characters & Animals: Pigs, piglets, chickens, chicks, roosters, geese, and goslings—plus traveling minstrels, jugglers, and performers.

  • Expanded Gameplay: Unlock new production chains, cook Festive Meals and design your own Festival Grounds.

  • 20 Minutes of Brand-New Music: Immerse yourself in the festive atmosphere with an original soundtrack featuring the lute, a new instrument making its debut in the game’s music.
